{{Top|leg}}
A '''shuttlebus''' was a type of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] public mass transit [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] used for transport in and around [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="GTLAA">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref> Shuttlebuses operated in [[Adascopolis]] on the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]<ref name="KOTOR16">[[Knights of the Old Republic 16|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 16]]</ref> and at the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]].<ref name="GTLAA" /> Shuttlebuses would take travelers arriving in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to elsewhere in the [[City/Legends|city]]. [[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|Arkanian Offshoots]], forced to live on the outskirts of Adascopolis, could also utilize shuttlebuses to reach their outlying settlements.<ref name="KOTOR16" />
